name: pixel-pet
description: A pixel pet above the prompt that acts out each tool call, takes clicks and drags, and stands on a bar of your context window; subagents type at desks beside it, and an HP/MP/ST HUD sits below

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: How quickly the pet runs and animates.

sleepAfter.title: Sleep after (seconds)
sleepAfter.description: Idle time before the pet falls asleep. 0 keeps it awake.

hud.title: HUD
hud.description: The HP, MP, and ST bars below the prompt.

targets.title: Name files and commands
targets.description: The status line names the file, pattern, command, host, or search query a tool works on. Turn it off to share your screen.

minis.title: Subagent minis
minis.description: A mini at its own desk on the band for each running subagent, which the pet walks along to check on.

contextBar.title: Context bar
contextBar.description: The context window as a bar under the pet, one color per part. Click it for the legend.

interactive.title: Clicks and drags
interactive.description: Click the pet to poke it, drag it along the band, and point at the context bar to name its parts.
